decisions.reason: As a 2023 product that remains marketed in 2024 and builds directly on the firm's coating-systems base, it likely performs near aspiration and is cheap enough in organizational slack to keep unless niche demand disappoints.

Its own product page in both years, close fit with the firm's injection business, and evidence of prior field testing suggest sufficiently satisfactory results relative to aspiration, so management would likely continue it.

Because it extends the established pump range and reuses proven air-motor technology, its technical and commercial risk is limited and the firm has little reason to redeploy resources away from it yet.

Although somewhat more adjacent than the pump products, it stayed on its own page through 2024 and fits the firm's push toward more future-oriented and interoperable solutions, which supports retention under available slack.

This newest 2024 launch has the shortest market record and therefore the highest uncertainty, but it is still close to the core spraying offer, so a medium-sized innovative firm in a growing industry would usually give it more time rather than drop it immediately.
